Calibrating and finding the overshoot protection value...

Please wait while we optimize your heating system. This process may take approximately 20 minutes.

areas.description: Settings related to thermostat, multi-room and temperature control. The radiators are in the same room as the inside sensor and the rooms have their own target temperatures separate from the system.
areas.title: Areas

automatic_gains.description:
This feature adjusts the control parameters of your heating system dynamically, optimizing temperature control for better comfort and energy efficiency. Enabling this option allows SAT to continuously adapt and fine-tune the heating settings based on the environmental conditions. This helps maintain a stable and comfortable environment without manual intervention.

Note: If you choose not to enable automatic gains, you will need to manually enter the PID values for precise temperature control. Please ensure that you have accurate PID values for your specific heating system to achieve optimal performance.
automatic_gains.title: Automatic Gains

calibrate_system.description:
Optimize your heating system by automatically determining the optimal PID values for your setup. When selecting Automatic Gains, please note that the system will go through a calibration process that may take approximately 20 minutes to complete.

Automatic Gains is recommended for most users as it simplifies the setup process and ensures optimal performance. However, if you're familiar with PID control and prefer to manually set the values, you can choose to skip Automatic Gains.

Please note that choosing to skip Automatic Gains requires a good understanding of PID control and may require additional manual adjustments to achieve optimal performance.

menu_options.calibrate: Calibrate and determine your overshoot protection value (approx. 20 min).
menu_options.overshoot_protection: Manually enter the overshoot protection value.

calibrate_system.title: Calibrate System

calibrated.description:
The calibration process has completed successfully.

Congratulations! Your Smart Autotune Thermostat (SAT) has been calibrated to optimize the heating performance of your system. During the calibration process, SAT carefully analyzed the heating characteristics and determined the appropriate overshoot protection value to ensure precise temperature control.

Overshoot Protection Value: {minimum_setpoint} °C

This value represents the maximum amount of overshoot allowed during the heating process. SAT will actively monitor and adjust the heating to prevent excessive overshooting, maintaining a comfortable and efficient heating experience in your home.

Please note that the overshoot protection value may vary depending on the specific characteristics of your heating system and environmental factors. It has been fine-tuned to provide optimal performance based on the calibration results.
calibrated.title: Calibration Completed

heating_system.description: Selecting the correct heating system type is important for SAT to accurately control the temperature and optimize performance. Choose the option that matches your setup to ensure proper temperature regulation throughout your home.

overshoot_protection.description:
By providing the overshoot protection value, SAT will adjust the control parameters accordingly to maintain a stable and comfortable heating environment. This manual configuration allows you to fine-tune the system based on your specific setup.

Note: If you are unsure about the overshoot protection value or have not performed the calibration process, it is recommended to cancel the configuration and go through the calibration process to let SAT automatically determine the value for optimal performance.
overshoot_protection.title: Overshoot Protection

pid_controller.description: Configure the proportional, integral, and derivative gains manually to fine-tune your heating system. Use this option if you prefer to have full control over the PID controller parameters. Adjust the gains based on your specific heating system characteristics and preferences.

serial.description:
To establish a connection with the OpenTherm Gateway using a socket connection, please provide the following details. In the Name field, enter a name for the gateway that will help you identify it within your system.

Specify the network address of the OpenTherm Gateway in the Device field. This could be in the format of "{example_device}", where "otgw.local" is the hostname or IP address of the gateway and "25238" is the port number.

These settings are essential for establishing communication and integration with your OpenTherm Gateway through the socket connection. Ensure that the provided details are accurate to ensure proper functionality.
serial.title: OpenTherm Gateway ( SERIAL )

esphome.description: Pick the ESPHome OpenTherm device that controls your boiler and enter a name for it.

simulator.description:
This gateway allows you to simulate a boiler for testing and demonstration purposes. Please provide the following information to configure the simulator.

Note: The Simulator Gateway is intended for testing and demonstration purposes only and should not be used in production environments.
simulator.title: Simulated Gateway ( ADVANCED )

switch.description:
Please fill in the following details to set up the switch. Enter a name for the switch in the Name field, which will help you identify it within your system. Choose the appropriate entity to use for your switch from the provided options.

In the Temperature Setting field, specify the desired target temperature for your heating system. If you are using a hot water boiler, fill in the Boiler Temperature Setting with the appropriate value. For electric heating systems, enter the value 100.

These settings are essential for precise temperature control and ensuring optimal performance of your heating system. Providing the correct Temperature Setting allows for accurate regulation and helps achieve a comfortable and energy-efficient environment in your home.
switch.title: PID Thermostat with PWM ( ON/OFF )

data_description.pid_controller_version: Adaptive is the newest and adjusts its gains to the house.

data_description.maximum_setpoint: The highest flow temperature SAT asks for. For underfloor heating at most 50 °C.
data_description.minimum_setpoint: The lowest flow temperature the boiler holds at minimum power. SAT sends it in PWM on-phases.
data_description.heating_curve_coefficient: Steepness of the heating curve: raise it if the house stays cold in frosty weather.
data_description.automatic_gains_value: How strongly the automatic gains react.
data_description.derivative_time_weight: Influence of the derivative term over time; it reduces undershoot while warming up.
data_description.proportional: Reacts to the current room error.
data_description.derivative: Damps the response to fast changes.
data_description.duty_cycle: The longest PWM cycle when the duty cycle is not automatic.
data_description.window_sensors: While one is open for the minimum time, heating pauses (Activity preset).

data_description.activity_temperature: Also used while a window is open.
data_description.sync_climates_with_preset: For the Sleep, Away and Activity presets.
data_description.push_setpoint_to_thermostat: Keeps the room thermostat attached to the boiler on the same target, as a backup if Home Assistant fails.

data_description.automatic_duty_cycle: Lets SAT choose the length of the PWM cycles.
data_description.cycles_per_hour: The most burner starts per hour PWM may use. The heat budget makes fewer.
data_description.sync_climates_with_mode: Heat and off are passed to the radiator and room thermostats.
data_description.frost_protection_temperature: While SAT is off, a room this cold is heated with 30 °C water until it is 1 °C warmer; then the boiler is handed back. 0 turns it off.
data_description.sensor_max_value_age: An older reading counts as a stalled sensor.
data_description.window_minimum_open_time: How long a window sensor must be open before heating pauses.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Leave these at their defaults unless you know why.

data.pwm_short_burns_threshold: Cut-short burns before a PWM on-phase ends
data.calibration_plateau_timeout: Calibration: wait for a steady flow

data_description.force_pulse_width_modulation: Also when the boiler could modulate down far enough.
data_description.learn_overshoot_protection: Starts from the calibrated value and adjusts it: up when the boiler stops PWM burns by overheating or cannot light, down when long burns level off below it. Calibrating again or changing the value starts over.
data_description.pwm_short_burns_threshold: 1 allows a single burn per on-phase (default 2).
data_description.maximum_relative_modulation: Caps the boiler's power, in percent.
data_description.climate_valve_offset: For room thermostats that don't report whether they heat: a room counts as wanting heat while it is at least this much below its target.
data_description.target_temperature_step: Step of the target temperature in the climate entity.
data_description.sample_time: The shortest time between two PID updates.
data_description.calibration_flame_timeout: How long the calibration waits for the burner to light.
data_description.calibration_plateau_timeout: How long the calibration heats while waiting for a steady flow temperature.
data_description.thermal_comfort: Controls on the felt temperature from temperature and humidity. Needs a humidity sensor.
data_description.simulation: SAT calculates everything but sends nothing to the boiler.

heat_budget.title: Heat budget
heat_budget.description: For slow emitters such as screed underfloor heating: SAT learns how much heat the house needs and burns it in long blocks at minimum power.

data_description.heat_budget_mode: Learn only shows the plan in the climate attributes without controlling. Until the house is learned (about 36 hours) the normal PWM controls.
data_description.heat_loss_coefficient: Heat the house loses per degree between inside and outside. 0 learns it (recommended).
data_description.heat_budget_period: Credit is added every period; longer periods give fewer, longer burns.
data_description.heat_budget_minimum_burn: The shortest block worth lighting the burner for; less heat waits for the next period.
data_description.weather_forecast_entity_id: Hourly forecast: the budget plans with the next three hours and learns the solar gain from the cloud cover.
data_description.comfort_schedule_entity_id: A schedule that is on when the house should be at the target. The recovery starts early enough to be warm on time.
data_description.setback_temperature: How much cooler the house is kept outside the schedule. A screed floor saves little with large setbacks.
data_description.warm_weather_shutdown_temperature: Heating switches off while the daily mean outside temperature is at or above this, and back on 2 °C below. Hot water keeps working. 0 keeps heating on.

boiler.title: Boiler and service
boiler.description: What SAT knows about the boiler, the valves and the costs.

data.keep_heating_in_pwm_off: Keep heating enabled between PWM on-phases
data.gas_energy_content: Heat per cubic metre of gas

data_description.keep_heating_in_pwm_off: The pump keeps circulating and a combi boiler does not swing its diverter valve to the cylinder after every burn. SAT disables heating when the water nears the boiler's lowest setpoint, so the boiler does not light briefly.
data_description.boiler_anti_cycling_time: The boiler's own wait before it relights. 0 keeps the defaults.
data_description.valve_opening_time: How long the actuators of the room thermostats take to open. SAT waits this long before lighting the boiler for a loop that just opened.
data_description.screed_maximum_temperature: Flow above this for 3 minutes raises a repair issue. 0 turns it off.
data_description.condensing_boiler: For the efficiency estimate without a flue gas sensor.
data_description.gas_energy_content: About 10.2 kWh/m³ for natural gas, 24 for propane. Used for the gas, heat and water flow estimates.
data_description.gas_price: Including distribution, in your currency. 0 turns the cost sensor off.
data_description.last_service_date: A repair issue reminds you when the next service is due.

hot_water.description: The cylinder temperature SAT sends to the boiler.

data_description.hot_water_comfort_temperature: 0 leaves the hot water to the boiler.
data_description.hot_water_eco_temperature: Outside the schedule's hours; 0 uses the hot water temperature all day.
data_description.hot_water_schedule_entity_id: A schedule that is on in the hours hot water is used.
data_description.water_meter_entity_id: A total water meter (litres or m³). The cylinder check then leaves out heating starts with a tap open and counts the reheats no water use explains.
data_description.legionella_day: Once a week the cylinder is held at 60 °C for an hour.

presence.title: Presence and windows
presence.description: When nobody is home SAT switches to Away; an open window pauses heating.

data.window_detection: Detect open windows from the temperature

data_description.presence_entity_ids: People, device trackers, zones or groups. Away after 30 minutes with nobody home.
data_description.proximity_entity_id: A distance sensor (Proximity integration), so a slow floor starts warming early.
data_description.return_distance: How close someone must be for the heating to come back; 0 waits until they are home.
data_description.window_detection: Without contact sensors: a drop of 0.8 °C in 10 minutes or 0.3 °C in 30 minutes pauses heating until the room stops cooling (2 hours at most). Needs a sensor with tenths of a degree.

reset_integral.description: This service resets the integrating part of the PID controller for the specified climate entity. This may be useful if the integral value has become too large or if the PID controller's performance has degraded.

measure_loops.description: Measures the water flow of each heating loop by turning the room thermostats off and opening them one at a time while the burner runs at minimum power. Takes about 15 minutes per room; the thermostats are put back afterwards and the result comes as a notification.

setup_failed.title: SAT {title} is not controlling the boiler
setup_failed.description:
Setting up {title} failed and Home Assistant keeps retrying: {error}

While it retries, the room thermostat attached to the boiler is in control.

low_water_pressure.title: {title}: low water pressure
low_water_pressure.description: The heating system pressure is {pressure} bar. Top the system up to about 1.2–1.5 bar (cold) and check for leaks or a flat expansion vessel if it keeps dropping. This issue clears itself above 0.9 bar.

boiler_fault.title: {title}: the boiler reports a fault
boiler_fault.description: The boiler reports a fault (manufacturer code {code}). Check the boiler display and its manual. This issue clears itself when the boiler no longer reports the fault.

frequent_flame_loss.title: {title}: the boiler often loses its flame
frequent_flame_loss.description: {count} heating burns of {title} lost their flame in the last day and the boiler had to light again. A few are normal; this many usually mean a worn or misplaced ionisation electrode, flue gas drawn back into the air intake (wind, a leaking flue), low gas pressure at peak times or a burner that needs calibrating. Have the boiler serviced. This issue clears itself when the flame holds again.

cylinder_cools_in_heating.title: {title}: heating cools the hot water cylinder
cylinder_cools_in_heating.description: With no hot water drawn, the cylinder of {title} has cooled by about {drop} K in the first minutes of a heating burn (median of the last burns). Heating water probably reaches the cylinder coil when heating starts: the diverter valve may not close fully or not switch cleanly. Each drop brings the next cylinder reheat forward. Mention it at the next service; the issue clears itself when the drop is below 1 K.

heat_exchanger_fouling.title: {title}: the heat exchanger may need cleaning
heat_exchanger_fouling.description: In settled heating burns the flue gas has been about {gap} K warmer than the return water over the last day. A clean condensing boiler stays within a few kelvin, so the heat exchanger or the burner may need a service.

pressure_falling.title: {title}: water pressure keeps falling
pressure_falling.description: The water pressure of {title} fell by {per_week} bar a week over the last days, to {pressure} bar. Look for a leak or a failing expansion vessel before the boiler locks out.

screed_overheat.title: {title}: flow water too hot for the floor
screed_overheat.description: {title} sent {flow} °C to the floor for minutes, above the {limit} °C limit. Check the boiler's maximum heating temperature.

low_water_flow.title: {title}: too little water through the heating
low_water_flow.description: The flow of {title} ran {spread} K warmer than the return in settled burns. Too little water moves: check the loops, the filter and for air in the system.

boiler_service_due.title: {title}: boiler service due
boiler_service_due.description: The service of {title} was due on {due}.

gas_use_increased.title: {title}: gas use went up
gas_use_increased.description: {title} used {percent} % more gas per degree day last week than in the weeks before. Look for an open window, a closed loop or a boiler problem.

mould_risk.title: {title}: mould risk in {rooms}
mould_risk.description: Over the last day the air at the coldest surfaces of {rooms} (outside wall corners, window reveals) was at about {humidity} % relative humidity on average. Mould grows from about 80 %. The room humidity is high for the outside temperature: air the rooms more often or longer, use the bathroom and kitchen fans, dry laundry outside the flat, and keep furniture a few centimetres off outside walls. The issue clears itself once the daily mean is below 75 %.
